pins.definition: Having a pleasant, comfortable degree of heat.
Having a moderately high, pleasant temperature; or (of clothes) keeping the body warm.
Having a pleasant temperature between cool and hot; keeping the body warm.

situation: A person sitting on a porch on a chilly autumn morning wraps their hands around a heavy ceramic mug steaming with fresh tea.
subject: the pleasant heat of the mug
brief: A close-up shot focuses on a person's hands tightly cradling a rustic ceramic mug.
